description: This file implements a factory for creating a high-level clock controller for a DU (Distributed Unit) in a 5G NR context, including classes for managing timer sources, cell tickers, and master clock state synchronization.

classes.name: io_timer_multi_source
classes.description: Manages timer ticking modes (automatic and manual) and provides manual tickers for cells.

classes.name: du_high_time_source_impl
classes.description: Implements the mac_clock_controller interface, managing cell timers, master clock state, and slot indications for DU high layer.

classes.name: du_high_time_source_impl::cell_ticker
classes.description: Represents a cell-specific ticker controlling individual cell timing and deactivation.

methods.name: create_manual_ticker
methods.description: Creates a manual ticker, switching the timer source to manual mode if it's the first.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the clock controller, returning a cell ticker.

methods.name: get_timer_manager
methods.description: Returns reference to the timer manager.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot indications from cells, updates master clock, and triggers cell tickers.

methods.name: handle_cell_activation
methods.description: Activates a cell, initializing its ticker and setting the master clock.

methods.name: handle_cell_deactivation
methods.description: Deactivates a cell and updates the master clock state.
